keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «주노가 무서워서 못 하겠다고 한 것(문제)» 과 «용기를 내 노래를 부르기 시작한 것(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Juno was scared and said he could not sing) and the solution (he began to sing at the concert). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Juno was too shy and scared to sing at the concert.
He practiced every day and sang in front of everyone.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: Juno was a shy boy who loved to sing alone in his room.
His teacher heard him one day and asked him to sing at the school concert.
a show where people play music or sing
Every day after school, Juno practiced his song a little more.
did something again and again to get better
On the night of the concert, his legs felt weak behind the curtain.
a big cloth that hangs in front of a stage
When the song ended, the whole room clapped and cheered.
Juno learned that courage means doing something even when you feel scared.
being brave when you are afraid

qs.q: Why did Juno first say, "I can't"?
qs.qko: 주노는 처음에 왜 «못 하겠어요» 라고 했나요?
opts: He was afraid that everyone would look at him.
He did not know any songs.
He was sick on that day.
evs: His teacher heard him one day and asked him to sing at the school concert.
Juno's hands shook, and he said, "I can't. Everyone will look at me."
But his teacher said, "Your voice is beautiful. Let's practice together."
Juno was a shy boy who loved to sing alone in his room.
why: 주노는 손이 떨렸고, 모두가 자기를 쳐다볼 거라고 말했어요. 사람들 앞이 무서웠던 거예요.
Juno's hands shook, and he said everyone would look at him. He was afraid.

qs.q: What does "quietly at first and then more strongly" show about Juno?
qs.qko: «처음에는 조용히, 그다음에는 더 힘차게» 라는 말은 주노에 대해 무엇을 보여 주나요?
opts: He became braver as he sang.
He forgot the words of the song.
The music was too loud for him.
evs: Then he began to sing, quietly at first and then more strongly.
When the song ended, the whole room clapped and cheered.
Every day after school, Juno practiced his song a little more.
His teacher heard him one day and asked him to sing at the school concert.
why: 처음엔 작게 부르다가 점점 힘차게 불렀어요. 노래하면서 점점 용기가 생겼다는 뜻이에요.
He sang quietly at first and then more strongly, so he grew braver while singing.

qs.q: What helped Juno get ready to sing at the concert?
qs.qko: 주노가 음악회에서 노래할 수 있도록 도운 것은 무엇인가요?
opts: His teacher's kind words and his daily practice.
A new microphone from his family.
A friend who sang the song for him.
evs: But his teacher said, "Your voice is beautiful. Let's practice together."
Every day after school, Juno practiced his song a little more.
When the song ended, the whole room clapped and cheered.
On the night of the concert, his legs felt weak behind the curtain.
why: 선생님이 목소리가 아름답다며 함께 연습하자고 했고, 주노는 날마다 조금씩 더 연습했어요. 두 문장을 이으면 알 수 있어요.
His teacher said his voice was beautiful and offered to practice together, and Juno practiced every day.

ends: Juno sings a song with his classmates.
주노가 반 친구들과 함께 노래를 불러요.
Juno helps a shy friend speak in class.
주노가 수줍음 많은 친구가 수업 시간에 말하도록 도와요.

write.src: “I can’t <u>sing very loudly yet</u>, but I can <u>practice a little every day</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «아직 못 하는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can't do yet and what you can do in English.

chips.b: kick my legs in the water
chips.label: swim

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «but I can» 뒤에 «동사 + 언제» 를 넣어 보세요. (예: but I can try again tomorrow)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «but I can», write a verb + when. (e.g. but I can try again tomorrow)
